subject: MLK Day Event Planning
overview: The commission approved previous meeting minutes, discussed planning and logistics for an upcoming MLK Day event at the public library, and reviewed organizational recommendations from Safe Medford. It also formed a three-person subcommittee to coordinate the MLK event.

items.title: Welcome and Introductions
items.summary: Commission members and attendees introduced themselves.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the previous meeting minutes with a date correction noted by Frances Nwajei, followed by discussion on how minutes are archived and accessed online.

items.title: Meeting Protocol and Culture of Respect
items.summary: Members discussed meeting norms, communication, and establishing ground rules or shared tenets for commission discussions.

items.title: MLK Day Event Planning and ARPA Funding
items.summary: The commission discussed plans to host a book discussion and family-friendly programming at the Medford Public Library for MLK weekend, and Frances Nwajei confirmed approval of nearly $5,000 in ARPA funding for commission outreach supplies, brochures, and event support.

items.title: Safe Medford Recommendations and Commission Priorities
items.summary: Commissioners debated how to prioritize and operationalize the roles and recommendations submitted by Safe Medford, focusing on community engagement and education.

items.title: MLK Event Subcommittee
items.summary: The commission formed a three-person subcommittee comprising Kelly Cunha, Diane McDonald, and Chelli Keshavan to organize the January 14 library event without violating Open Meeting Law.
